hooks.command:
python3 -c "
import sys, json, re, subprocess
from datetime import datetime
data = json.load(sys.stdin)
cmd = data.get('tool_input', {}).get('command', '')
if not re.search(r'\\bgit\\s+push\\b', cmd): sys.exit(0)
now = datetime.now()
verze = f'Verze {now.day}. {now.month}. {now.year} {now.strftime(\"%H:%M\")}'
f = 'docs/index.html'
text = open(f).read()
new_text = re.sub(r'Verze \\d+\\. \\d+\\. \\d{4}( \\d{2}:\\d{2})?', verze, text)
if new_text == text: sys.exit(0)
open(f, 'w').write(new_text)
subprocess.run(['git', 'add', f])
subprocess.run(['git', 'commit', '-m', f'aktualizuj verzi v patičce: {verze}'])
print(f'Footer updated and committed: {verze}')
" 2>/dev/null || true
